units.source_text: 离开东京的老家时，妻子吩咐过：现在正是飞蛾产卵的季节，西服不要挂在衣架或墙壁上。

en.t: When he was leaving his home in Tokyo, his wife had warned him: this was just the season when moths laid their eggs, so he should not hang his suit on a clothes rack or on the wall.

units.source_text: 来了以后，果然发现吊在客栈房檐下的装饰灯上落着六七只黄褐色的大飞蛾。

en.t: After he arrived, he found, just as expected, six or seven large yellowish-brown moths settled on the decorative lamp hanging beneath the inn's eaves.

units.source_text: 隔壁三铺席房间的衣架也落了一只，它虽小，但躯干却很粗壮。

en.t: On the clothes rack in the neighboring three-mat room, there was another moth; though small, its body was thick and sturdy.
